existing_workflow_behavior.trigger: 1st of each month at 06:00 UTC, or manual dispatch
existing_workflow_behavior.what_it_does: Runs python -m plugin_examples run --family {cells} to generate new examples
what_it_does_NOT_do: Does not compare this run against prior run (no --compare-run flag)
Does not verify published examples still build in target repo

evidence_validation_step.description: After generation run, validate evidence completeness

run_to_run_comparison_step.description: Compare this run against prior run to detect regressions

Did the denominator api_catalog_sha256 change? (check cells.json, words.json, pdf.json)
Are all 17 scenario contracts still valid? (run test_scenario_contracts.py)
